title: uno: MS1-only peptide and protein identification
description: uno is a Rust MS1-only search engine in the spirit of DirectMS1 and ms1searchpy. It searches LC-MS peptide features (from biosaur2, koth, or built-in koth feature finding on mzML, Bruker timsTOF and Thermo RAW files), scores candidates with retention-time and ion-mobility prediction, and estimates FDR with target-decoy competition.
